_about: Held-out data for the precision claim (plan Phase 1 item 5). Rule authors must not inspect findings on anything listed here, read its labels while writing or tuning a rule, or copy its code into planted fixtures. Only aggregate scores are reported. Each top-level key is one held-out set, so sets added on other branches merge side by side.

ai_corpus_heldout.labels: one independent labelling subagent per language, committed before Arbiter was run on the tree; no reconciliation
ai_corpus_heldout.guard: tools/gold/guards.json target ai-corpus-heldout (aggregate: counts and digest only)
